[S1] (group_health_overview.md) # Evergreen Life Group Benefits: Health Plan Overview Evergreen Life offers two group health plans: Standard and Enhanced. **Standard plan:** annual deductible of $100 per person ($200 per family). After the deductible, eligible expenses are reimbursed at 80%. **Enhanced plan:** no deductible. Eligible expenses are reimbursed at 90%. **Paramedical services** (physiotherapy, chiropractic, massage therapy): up to $500 per practitioner type per calendar year on Standard and $1,000 on Enhanced. **Waiting period:** new employees become eligible after a 3-month waiting period. Dependants are covered from the same date.
[S2] (prescription_drugs.md) # Prescription Drug Coverage Prescription drugs are reimbursed at 80% on Standard and 90% on Enhanced. **Generic substitution:** where a generic equivalent exists, reimbursement is based on the generic price. **Prior authorization:** required for any drug that costs more than $1,500 per 30-day supply. Your physician submits the request, and a decision is made within 5 business days. **Dispensing fee:** reimbursed up to $9.99 per prescription fill. **Specialty drugs:** must be filled through the specialty pharmacy program. **Vaccines:** publicly recommended adult vaccines are covered when prescribed by a pharmacist or physician.
[S3] (mental_health_coverage.md) # Mental Health Coverage **Psychologists, registered social workers and psychotherapists:** reimbursed at 80%, up to $1,500 per calendar year on Standard and $2,500 on Enhanced. No physician referral is needed. **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** up to 6 free counselling sessions per issue, available 24/7 at 1-800-555-0177. **In a crisis:** anyone in Canada can call or text 9-8-8 for the Suicide Crisis Helpline at any time.

sources:
[S1] (escalation_policy.md) # When to Transfer to a Human Agent Transfer the conversation to a human agent when: - the member is appealing a denied claim or wants to file a complaint - the member is reporting a death or bereavement - the member asks for legal advice or mentions legal action - the member shows signs of crisis or distress (share 9-8-8 and transfer immediately) - the member asks for a person twice, or the assistant has failed to answer after three attempts - the question cannot be answered from policy documents **Hours:** live agents are available 8am to 8pm Eastern, Monday to Friday. Outside those hours, create a callback request; a team member will respond within 1 business day. When transferring, pass along a short summary so the member does not have to repeat themselves.
[S2] (mental_health_coverage.md) # Mental Health Coverage **Psychologists, registered social workers and psychotherapists:** reimbursed at 80%, up to $1,500 per calendar year on Standard and $2,500 on Enhanced. No physician referral is needed. **Employee Assistance Program (EAP):** up to 6 free counselling sessions per issue, available 24/7 at 1-800-555-0177. **In a crisis:** anyone in Canada can call or text 9-8-8 for the Suicide Crisis Helpline at any time.
[S3] (privacy_and_identity.md) # Privacy and Identity Verification Before discussing any plan details, verify the member with their full name, date of birth and policy number. Staff and the virtual assistant never ask for a full card number, passwords, or a Social Insurance Number. Members should not share these details in chat. If shared, the message is blocked or redacted. Plan information is not shared with a spouse or other third party unless the member has given written authorization. Calls and chats are recorded for quality and training. Member data is stored in Canada. Members can request access to their personal information. We respond within 30 days.
